description: The file '/home/ga/Documents/JASP/Viagra.csv' is already open in JASP. This dataset is from a real pharmacological study (Field, 2013) examining the effect of Viagra on libido. It contains three columns: 'dose' (1=placebo, 2=low dose, 3=high dose), 'libido' (libido score), and 'partnerLibido'. Using JASP's ANOVA module, run a One-Way ANOVA. Set 'libido' as the Dependent Variable and 'dose' as the Fixed Factor. Under Additional Options, enable 'Descriptive statistics'. Also enable 'η²' (eta-squared) under Effect Size. Leave all other settings at their defaults.
